_readme: The live logger's composer (spec 024 fast path): the session vocabulary as a match
known_aliases), the unique exact match and the instant type-ahead over it, which set
the cursor is building, the likely next tune, what Enter does with typed text
(commitStep), and what a server /match verdict does to a placeholder (resolution).
The index is plain JSON: alias/name map a normalized key to tune ids, byId and next
are keyed by the tune id as a string, list is vocabulary order.
The cursor (insertAfterId) is logstate's: null, an id, {before: id} or {newSet: id}.
